functions.name: seq_tick
functions.plate:
Every 4 ms. Nothing while g_seq.stalled == 1.
1) 48 pending note-offs (SeqNote @0x10300) of non-paused ports: time -= tempo_scale; expired -> note-off pushed to the event ring and entry freed. Entries with bit24 (SEQ_NOTE_RETRIGGER, set by seq_continue when the ring was full) first push their note-on, then become plain note-offs (dropped if they expire first).
2) Sequence players g_seq.resume_port..7 with state == 1 (paused skipped): beat counter, delta countdown, then parse events until the next non-zero delta (format: docs/notes/sequence_format.md). Notes (b<0x80) push a note-on and queue the note-off with its gate time; channel messages 0xA0-0xEF are pushed; metas 0x81 call, 0x82 loop, 0x83 end, 0x84 tempo, 0x88-0x8F long gate/delta prefixes.
Ring full: error 0x20, resume at this port next tick. Overflow queue 0x10210 (60 words) holds stolen note-offs / events that did not fit; full -> stalled=1, error 0x60.
NOTE: seq_evq_push (0x4900) returns to lr on FULL and to lr+4 on success; the success paths 0x42F0 and 0x485C are only reached that way (Ghidra's decompilation shows only the full path).
All paths (both jump tables 0x45CC/0x4650) verified against the asm.
QUIRKS: see src/arm/sequencer.c (delta countdown test is unsigned: a negative delta stored by the ring-full exit sleeps ~2^32/tempo_scale ticks; steal picks the first prio-0 entry, else the LAST lowest-priority entry; stack imbalance when both queues are full -> returns to address <port>; event dropped when ring full and overflow queue empty; '>' vs '>=' wrap of the overflow pointers; unreachable purge loop at 0x4360).

functions.name: seq_add_delta
functions.signature: int seq_add_delta(SeqPlayer * p, uint d, byte * ptr)
functions.plate:
delta = d*tick_len + delta_extra + delta (the <=0 remainder); delta_extra = 0; cur = ptr. Returns the new delta in r3.
The mlas/mvnvs saturation is dead code (MLAS leaves V unchanged on ARMv4, V is clear at both call sites).

functions.name: seq_evq_push
functions.signature: void seq_evq_push(uint ev, uint wr_ofs, uint rd_ofs_m4)
functions.plate:
Pushes r5 into the event ring at write offset r6 unless r6 == r4 (= read offset - 4, loaded by the caller) and stores the new write offset to 0x13000 (r8) and in r6; clobbers r5.
Returns to lr if the ring is FULL and to lr+4 after a successful push (add lr,lr,#4): callers place their 'full' branch right after the bl.
QUIRK: r4 is not masked, so with read offset 0 the ring is never 'full' and the 1024th push empties it.

functions.name: port_clear_play
functions.plate: g_port[port].status &= ~PORT_FLG_PLAY (end of sequence, from seq_tick 0x4808).

functions.name: port_status_export
functions.plate:
Every 4 ms: publishes PortStatus records (0x20 bytes) for the SH-4 sd library getters:
  0x13600+i*0x20 MIDI port i (PortState i + SeqPlayer i): flags (|0x80 if err), vol-0x80, pan-0x80, speed-0x8000, pitch-0x8000, loop_iter, fx/direct lvl-0x80, beats, cur-base, err, err_hi
  0x13800+i*0x20 one-shot i (PcmPlayer i), 0x13A00+j*0x20 stream channel j = port*2+ch (PcmPlayer 8+j).
PCM position fields only while keyed on. One-shot total = (LEA-LSA)*(u8)loop_count + CA (only the low byte of loop_count!); stream total = loop_count*ring_len_in_samples + CA.

functions.name: ticks_since_cmd_inc
functions.plate: ticks_since_cmd (0x13410)++ every 4 ms; host_cmd_exec logs it with each command and clears it.

functions.name: port_vol_fade
functions.plate: Volume fade of the 8 MIDI ports: volume (+1) moves towards vol_target (+0) by vol_step (+4) every vol_interval (+2)+1 ticks (count +3); interval 0 = jump. Step -> vol_dirty (+5) = 1 and status |= CHG_VOL (4); reached -> status &= ~CHG_VOL.

functions.name: port_pan_fade
functions.plate:
Pan fade of the 8 MIDI ports (+6 target, +7 pan, +8 interval, +9 count, +0xA step), sets pan_dirty (+0xB).
QUIRK: sets CHG_VOL (4) while fading instead of CHG_PAN (0x10); CHG_PAN is only cleared.

functions.name: port_speed_fade
functions.plate: Speed fade of the 8 MIDI ports (+0x18 target, +0x1C speed, +0x20 interval, +0x21 count, step = +0x22 * 16). On each step: g_seq_player[i].tempo_scale = max(0, (speed & 0xFFFF) - 0x4000) (0x8000 -> 0x4000 = 1x), status |= CHG_SPEED (8).

functions.name: port_pitch_fade
functions.plate:
Pitch fade of the 8 MIDI ports (+0xC target, +0x10 pitch (1/256 semitone, 0x8000 = 0), +0x14 interval, +0x15 count, step = +0x16 * 2); step -> pitch_dirty (+0x17), status |= CHG_PITCH (0x20).
QUIRK: 'movcs r3,#0' at 0x693C (should be movcc): a downward fade jumps to the target on its first step.

functions.name: pcm_speed_fade
functions.plate:
Speed fade of the 24 PCM players (+0x40 target, +0x44 speed, +0x48 interval, +0x49 count, step = +0x4A*2); step -> pitch_dirty (+0x4B) = 0xFF, flags |= CHG_SPEED (8).
QUIRK: same inverted 'movcs' as port_pitch_fade (0x69E4): downward fades jump to the target.

functions.name: pcm_pitch_fade
functions.plate: Pitch fade of the 24 PCM players (+0x4C target, +0x50 pitch, +0x54 interval, +0x55 count, step = +0x56*2); step -> pitch_dirty = 0xFF, flags |= CHG_PITCH (0x20).

functions.name: pcm_pitch_update
functions.plate:
For each PCM player with pitch_dirty: clear it, pitch_ofs (+0x10) = lin(speed) + lin(pitch), where lin(v) converts v-0x8000 (1/256 semitone) to a signed AICA octave<<10|FNS offset via note_oct_tab[0x60 + semitones] and fns_lo_tab[semi*128 + fine] (+0x100 per threshold 0x1EF/0x383/0x4D9); out of range -> 0x1FFF; negative inputs use ~x|0x8000 and negate the result.
The speed term is parked in the image word 0x6C40.

functions.name: pcm_tick
functions.plate: Every 4 ms: one-shot players 0..7: flags = pcm_update(); if still keyed on flags = shot_monitor(). Stream channels 8..23: flags = pcm_update(); if keyed on stream_monitor().

functions.name: pcm_update
functions.plate:
Per PCM player. If keyed on: r10 = &g_pcm_slot[slot], r11 = AICA channel, MSLC = 48+slot (select for monitoring).
Volume fade (flags bit2; +0x14 interval, +0x15 step, +0x18 target, +0x1C count, +0x1E volume) and pan fade (bit4; +0x16/+0x17/+0x19/+0x1D/+0x1F). When keyed on writes TL byte (+0x29) = clamp(0x100 - 2*vol + tl_base) -> +0x20 and DIPAN byte (+0x24) = lin_to_aica[clamp(aica_to_lin[pan_base] + pan/4 - 32)] -> +0x21, then tail-calls 0x7DEC (pitch register = pitch_base + pitch_ofs).
Returns the new flags in r0.
QUIRK: decreasing has no clamp at 0: volume/pan < step wraps (u32) and its low byte is stored.

functions.name: shot_monitor
functions.plate:
One-shot player keyed on (after pcm_update selected its channel): 30 dummy reads of pl->start (monitor settle), then MON_EG bit15 (LP = loop/sample end passed):
  LP and LPCTL and (loops_left == 0 or --loops_left != 0) -> loop_count++;
  LP otherwise -> key off (KYONEX, ~KYONB), release player + slot (0x8204, keeping +0x23/+0x29), flags &= ~1, return.
Then (0x73F4) cur_pos/cur_addr from MON_CA. Returns flags in r0.

functions.name: stream_monitor
functions.plate:
Stream channel keyed on: 30 settle reads, loop_mode (+0x23) = MON_EG>>15 (LP), LP -> loop_count++ (ring wrapped).
0x73F4 pcm_store_pos (shared with shot_monitor): cur = MON_CA; if cur != 0: cur_pos (+4) = cur, cur_addr (+8) = start + (pcms>1 ? cur*2 : pcms==0 ? cur/2 : 1).
BUG: for pcms == 1 neither movgt nor movlt fires, r1 keeps pcms, so cur_addr = start + 1.
QUIRK: that scaling is the inverse of samples->bytes (16-bit should be *2, ADPCM /2); +8 is not exported.

functions.name: seq_init
functions.plate: Clears 0x10000-0x107FF (8 SeqPlayer, SeqGlobals + overflow queue, 48 SeqNote), tempo_scale = 0x4000 for all players, overflow read/write pointers = 0x10210, resume pointer = 0x10000. Boot and host commands (0x60BC, 0x613C).

functions.name: seq_play
functions.signature: uint seq_play(uint port, uint song, uint prio, byte * smsb)
functions.plate:
Host 0x01 sdMidiPlay (caller 0x4B9C checks SMSB magic, version 1 and ENDB). song >= count (smsb+0xC) -> err 0x04. Port playing: new prio != 0, old prio != 0 and new < old -> err 0x02; else seq_stop_player.
prio &= ~7 (host sends prio<<3; it becomes event bits 31:27). end = smsb + offs[song+1], or size-4 (ENDB) when offs[song+1] reads the 'SMSD' tag of song 0 (last song). base = smsb+offs[song]; timebase = base[1]; beat_len = beat_count = base[2]; tick_len = timebase*beat_len>>4; beats = 0; cur = base+12; state = 1. Returns state in r1 (1).
Errors are ORed into g_seq.err (0x10200); returns state byte [r11+1].
QUIRK: on err 0x04 r11 is not yet set up (host_cmd_poll's slot counter) -> returns a byte of the vector table.

functions.name: seq_stop
functions.plate: Host 0x02 sdMidiStop (+0x519C, 0x59B8): r11 = &g_seq_player[port&7], falls into seq_stop_player. Returns state in r1.

functions.name: seq_stop_player
functions.plate: Clears SEQ_PLAYING and the playback fields (prio, call/loop state, end, timebase, tick_len, delta, extras, beat_len; keeps cur/base/beats/loop_iter/tempo_scale), frees this port's pending note-offs WITHOUT sending them, then branches to 0x7618 (seq_purge_port, in seq_pause): zero this port's note-ons still in the event ring and voices_key_off_port. Returns state in r1.

functions.name: seq_pause
functions.plate: Host 0x03 sdMidiPause: state |= SEQ_PAUSED (even when idle). If it was playing: 0x7618 seq_purge_port = zero the port's note-on events in the ring (do-while from read to write offset: scans all 1024 slots when the ring is empty) and voices_key_off_port. Pending note-offs stay queued, frozen (seq_tick skips paused ports). Returns state in r1.

functions.name: seq_continue
functions.plate:
Host 0x04 sdMidiContinue: if paused, clear SEQ_PAUSED; if playing, push a note-on (pending note-off | 0x01000000) for every queued note of the port, re-triggering the held notes. Ring full -> mark this and remaining entries with bit24 (seq_tick sends them), err 0x20.
QUIRK: the write offset is only stored when all fitted (0x76CC); on 'full' the note-ons already written are lost. Returns state in r1.

functions.name: seq_break_loop
functions.plate: Host 0x0C (not emitted by sd 1.00.18): loop_left = 0 -> the active meta-0x82 loop ends at its next end marker.

functions.name: pcm_init
functions.plate:
Boot: clears the 24 PcmPlayer records (0x11000), neutral targets/values (0x80 / 0x8000), fx_ch = 0x80; stream channels: pan_base 0x1F (even, left) / 0x0F (odd, right), disdl_base 0x0F. Slot table 0x12080: 16 x {0, 0, &AICA_CH[48+n]}.
QUIRK: the clear loop writes 0x5C bytes per record (offset 0x58 included) -> also clears 0x11840 after the last record.

labels.name: g_midi_status
labels.comment: MIDI port status for the SH-4 (port_status_export)

labels.name: ticks_since_cmd
labels.comment: 4 ms ticks since the last host command (logged by host_cmd_exec)

labels.name: seq_jt_45cc
labels.comment: seq_tick channel-message table by (status-0x90)>>4: 9n nop, An/Bn 2 data, Cn/Dn 1 data, En pitch bend, Fn nop

labels.name: seq_cmd_jt
labels.comment: seq_tick meta 0x80-0x8F: 80 nop, 81 call, 82 loop, 83 end, 84 tempo, 85-87 nop, 88-8B long gate, 8C-8F long delta

labels.name: seq_tick_retrig_pushed
labels.comment: lr+4 return of seq_evq_push (retrigger note-on pushed)

labels.name: seq_next_event
labels.comment: count an event for meta 0x81, then parse

labels.name: seq_parse
labels.comment: end check, cur = ptr, read status byte

labels.name: seq_ev_note
labels.comment: b<0x80: note 0 ll w cccc, note, vel, gate[ll+1], delta[1+w]

labels.name: seq_end
labels.comment: 0x83 or end of data: clear player, port_clear_play

labels.name: seq_emit
labels.comment: drain overflow queue, then push the event
